summary: T17 Feishu: new src/providers/feishu/index.mjs registered in the provider registry. Outbound is the custom-bot webhook with an interactive card and the official HMAC timestamp/sign body fields; inbound is the Lark SDK WebSocket long connection, loaded lazily (typed UNSUPPORTED when the optional SDK is absent), isolated with a per-client bounded HttpInstance (finite timeout, no shared-instance mutation) and a start/handshake deadline, with a no-op logger. Text events and card actions normalize to envelopes; non-text messages are acknowledged then dropped, never injected into the Host. Docs: CHANGELOG/HANDOFF/docs/PROGRESS.md/docs/architecture.md updated. Verification: npm run check passes (75 source files); npm test 396 pass / 0 fail (86 protocol). Real devices/accounts remain out of scope.
